verdict.rationale: Gemini's own docs say users can delete their Gemini Apps activity and turn off Keep Activity at any time, which covers both deletion and retention control. Related docs on training use of chats, files and Live media support the privacy posture. missing for 10: documented auto-delete periods or retention windows, details on what happens to data after deletion, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: You can review your prompts, delete your Gemini Apps activity, and turn off Keep Activity in My Activity at any time.
Your chats and uploaded files in Gemini Apps won’t be reviewed by human reviewers or otherwise used to improve generative AI models.
